transforms.A1_atom_rotation: rotate every LeapAtom.offset / RayAtom.direction by coordinates.rotate_offset; all other fields unchanged
transforms.A2_rotation_rederived: A1 plus re-derived drop masks and promotion zones from the rotated atoms (secondary, not part of the decision)
transforms.B_type_relabel: fixed order-reversing permutation of type ids with every id-keyed field remapped

design.endpoint: per-type normalized_board_value / normalized_hand_value / promotion_option_value and per-rule median_non_anchor_value; violation = any mismatch under the bijection preserving the movement-signature multiset
design.decision_rule: 0 violations and 0 unsupported/mismatched rules in both primary transforms -> profile_transform_invariant; any violation -> transform_sensitive_with_mechanism; otherwise inconclusive
design.serialize_parse_round_trip_control: compile(ruleset_from_dict(ruleset_to_dict(ruleset))) must keep fingerprint and profile identical
